messages:
Aisha (hw-partner): Quick vendor sync request — we need a final gating decision for the H100/H200/MI300/Gaudi announcement planned for mid-April. Can vendors confirm firmware/driver sign-off by Apr 10? cc @Marco :calendar:
Marco (partnerships): fwiw NVIDIA asked for an embargo til Apr 15, AMD (MI300) is fine earlier, Gaudi team flagged a late microcode drop. Risk: if we wait for all, GA slips. Possible options: 1) staggered region/SKU announcement, 2) announce GA date but call out initial SKUs, 3) push to Apr 25. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
DevBot: CI notice — marketplace-image build #342 queued -> failed on MI300 smoke tests. Err snippet: "kernel panic - crash at 0x7fffab3c". Full logs: https://ci.internal/reports/342 (automated)
Lena (sw-integrations): On the integration side, MI300 failure looks like a kernel-driver mismatch with our staging kernel. We can re-run against the vendor-supplied kernel image but will need a 48-72h window. Proposed mitigation: create a 'beta' tag for MI300 SKUs and keep H100/H200 in the initial rollout if they pass.
Sam (product): Customers expect GA around Apr 20 from roadmap comms. If vendors push embargo past Apr 10 we need a comms fallback: either a soft GA (beta SKUs) or delay the public announcement. Also we can't commit to Dedicated SLAs until the SI pass completes for each SKU.
Marco (partnerships): Suggest runbook (short):
- Apr 5: vendor embargo windows confirmed (owner: Aisha)
- Apr 6-9: final SI test run (owner: Lena)
- Apr 10: decide public GA vs staggered skus (owner: Marco)
- Apr 11-14: marketplace images baked and smoke-tested (owner: eng-release)
